recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-16485 unless Vocab later changes the concept permanence or code-system-version policy.
issue_request: FHIR-16485 was a Published/Persuasive Vocab change request for the FHIR-core terminologies page, asking section 4.1.1 to identify code system version as necessary when code and system alone are not unique because concept permanence rules are not followed.
initial_application: The request was applied by commit 2d9feb5dd157d4192cc025587141fe1ba677128a and merged through PR #1982 as 4ff43310c995035c43fce466bb283c6dc4b8b3e2, replacing the old Code Pair paragraph in source/terminologies.html with the approved code system identifier, concept identifier, and version guidance.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini maps resourceType to terminologies and source/terminologies.html is titled Using Codes and Terminologies with a Using Codes in Resources heading, confirming build scope. Later edits only adjusted links, ValueSet.url wording, and punctuation around the paragraph. Vocab minutes from 2022-02-28 and 2022-06-15 confirm removal of the Code Pairs reference, addition of replacement text, reopening, re-vote, resolution, and application. No Zulip exact-key hit for FHIR-16485 was found.
reconciliation: No source change was made because source/terminologies.html already states that code system version may be necessary to achieve uniqueness when the code system does not follow concept permanence rules, and still distinguishes value set URI from code system URI while identifying concepts by code and system.
